description: The signs of generated text on a site's pages: hidden characters that can carry a watermark or hidden instructions (with any message spelled out in tag characters), chat and markdown left in, placeholders never filled in, stock phrasing, and heavy use of dashes. Strong signs first. A sign is not proof. Site text comes under "quoted".

offset.description: How many to skip, for the next part of a long list.

show.description: strong (the default): pages with hidden or left-in text; all: any sign.

site.description: The site, as a domain such as example.com.

name: mttr_tells
title: Find signs of generated text
